propositions: ADR corpus contains 91 files but only 69 distinct numbers, with 17 collision groups including 5 unrelated ADRs all numbered 0037, causing ambiguity in bare ADR references

Pre-merge CI uniqueness checks are inherently racy; the race-free prevention mechanism is per-number marker files `docs/adr/.numbers/NNNN` whose content is the ADR filename, producing add/add git conflicts on number collision

22 duplicate-numbered ADRs are renumbered to 0070-0091 in ascending landing-date order (earliest-landed per collision group retains its original number), with the mapping recorded in docs/adr/RENUMBERING.md
All `adr/NNNN-slug` cross-references in docs/ and src/ that named a moved ADR are rewritten to its new number, with resolution tier and ambiguous references recorded in RENUMBERING.md
A CI gate (scripts/check_adr_numbers.py) enforces bijection between ADRs and marker files, unique numbers, and referential integrity (no dangling slug links), exiting non-zero on violations
